en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from one of our companions, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from the one who narrated it, said,

‘Whenever Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was given the good news of a birth did not ask, ‘Is it a male or a female, until he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Is it unimpaired?’ So if it was unimpaired, said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who did not Create from me<sup>asws</sup> anything deformed’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from certain persons of our people from Muhammad ibn Sinan from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “

Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When one receives the news of the birth of his child one must not ask, “Is it a boy or a girl?’ One must ask, ‘Is it of complete physical condition?’ If the child is of complete physical condition one must say, ‘All praise belongs to Allah who has not created from me a defective child.’”
